skills.name: Tanuki Claws
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Tanuki Cloak
skills.desc:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Enter a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds. If hit during this time, parry the attack and inflict massive Daze against the attacking enemy.
Successfully parrying an attack gains 1 Sugar Points.
Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.

skills.name: Hard Candy Shot
skills.desc:
When Yuzuha has Sugar Points, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing Physical DMG. When this attack lands a a heavy attack, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point. Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot is considered an Aftershock.
Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot can be triggered once every 8s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Sugarburst Sparkles
skills.desc:
Enemies under the effect of Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles once every 1s.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles initially deals Physical DMG.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 8.5%.
*Stats shown are at Base level.

skills.name: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max
skills.desc:
Enemies under the effect of Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max when hit with a heavy attack from Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot or Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max initially deals Physical DMG.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 8.5%.
*Stats shown are at Base level.

skills.name: Tanuki Helper
skills.desc:
When Yuzuha is off-field, tanuki Kama assists the active character in attacking enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
When Yuzuha performs Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak, tanuki Kama joins her in attacking the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Tanuki Kama inherits Yuzuha's initial ATK.
rows: Tanuki Kama & Yuzuha Coordinated Attack DMG Multiplier

skills.name: Did I Scare You?
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: You're Outta Luck!
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Time for Payback~
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dessert Time
skills.desc:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Replenish Your Fun
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon a successful parry, gain 1 Sugar Points.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: We Have Cookies
skills.desc:
After triggering a Defensive Assist or successfully parrying an enemy attack with Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot
skills.desc:
After triggering a Defensive Assist or successfully parrying an enemy attack with Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak, press [Basic Attack] to at the right moment to activate:
Following a continuous spinning umbrella attack, fire a powerful projectile that deals Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Gummy Bombardment
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Cavity Alert
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Cavity Alert, Right Now!
skills.desc:
After using Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~, Quick Assist: Dessert Time, Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies, or Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, or when a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
On hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the Sweet Scare state.
Gains 2 Sugar Points upon activation.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Sweet Scare
skills.desc:
The Sweet Scare state lasts for 18s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by Sweet Scare is first hit by an active character of their attribute, Flavor Match is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max against the enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When Sweet Scare is triggered again on an enemy, their existing Flavor Match state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles and Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max again.
*Stats shown are at Base level.

skills.name: Prank Assault
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Gains 1 Sugar Points when used.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press [Ultimate] to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike one enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the Sweet Scare state.
Upon activating this skill other squad members gain 8.5 Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 Sugar Points.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
*Stats shown are at Base level.

skills.name: Whimsical Wonder
skills.desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, Yuzuha immediately gains 3 Sugar Points.
Yuzuha can have up to 6 Sugar Points.
When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members receive the Tanuki Wish effect.
Tanuki Wish grants an ATK increase equal to 40% of Yuzuha's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 600, and increases the DMG dealt by those with the effect by 15%, lasting up to 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Yuzuha's initial ATK reaches 1,500, she grants the full ATK bonus to all squad members.
*Stats shown are at Base level.
rows: Tanuki Wish grants ATK based on Yuzuha's initial ATK

skills.name: The More the Merrier
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
If Yuzuha's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, every point over increases the Anomaly Buildup Rate of characters with Tanuki Wish by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 20%, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG by 0.2%, up to maximum of 20%. When Yuzuha's Anomaly Mastery is at 200, she grants the full buff.
*Stats shown are at Base level.

cons.name: Lucky Constitution
cons.desc:
Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most every 180s.
Enemies in the Sweet Scare state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG buff from her Additional Ability is increased to 130% of its original value.

cons.name: Full of Colorful Company
cons.desc:
When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hit an enemy that is not triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced Chain Attacks can only occur once every 20s.
Whenever another character enters through a Chain Attack, Yuzuha gains 1 Sugar Points.
Yuzuha's Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot cooldown is reduced by 25%.

cons.name: Fairytale of the Haunted City
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. + 2

cons.name: Falling Magic
cons.desc: The DMG of Yuzuha's Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot and Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies increase by 30%, Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a Quick Assist when it hits an enemy.

cons.name: Dreams of a Fading Winter
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Put Down Roots
cons.desc:
Gain 1 additional Sugar Points when successfully parrying an enemy attack using a Defensive Assist or Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak. When using a Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, hold [Basic Attack] to charge for up to 0.8 seconds. Releasing [Basic Attack] or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as Physical DMG.
If any powerful shell from Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot hits an enemy, all squad members' Disorder DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, an stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under Sweet Scare, it'll trigger 1 Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max attack.
If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.

rec.sub: 攻击力百分比、异常精通
